titles.title: Tree with Cut Limb

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: A large, green, leafy tree and its limbs fill much of this canvas.  A limb toward the upper left corner of the work has been cut off, leaving an exposed circle of orange-colored wood where the branch once was.  A small amount of blue sky peaks out from behind the tree, mainly on the right side of the work.
